profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Security+
profile.summary:
Welcome to my page and thank you for stopping by!

My name is Quinn and I've been a full stack developer since late 2019. Upon completion of my 4 year contract with the US navy of the aforementioned year, I decided to pursue an old, forgotten passion of mine. My uncle, a man to whom I've looked up for as long as I can remember, reminded me of my desire to learn computer science and programming by recommending a course another one of his nephews had taken with success.

I attribute the foundation of my knowledge in full stack development to the 3 month boot camp coding course named Sabio. From Sabio, I had learned the Microsoft .NET stack to maintain and create web applications using JavaScript's React library styled with the Bootstrap framework for client side interfaces. Not only did I learn the technical skills to digitally bring ideas to life, but also communication and collaboration through code reviews, sprint planning in Trello, and version control with Git Bash in a cohort of 16 other developers. Not only was I trained the fundamentals and concepts of the frameworks and languages, but I was given the chance to hone my newly acquired abilities with a real client and product under the tutelage and mentorship of a highly seasoned product leader.

Only after a month of completing the boot camp course, I landed my first job as a programmer with Big Brand Tire & Service. I worked there for three years building upon my foundation from Sabio and strengthening my knowledge of the software development lifecycle as a professional. Also during that time, I met the love of my life and gained quirky, yet funny and amazing stepson.

I currently work for Pacific Dental Services as a Jr. Software Developer with all the skills and experience I've gained from Big Brand Tire and Sabio on top of the new languages and programs I've picked up since being hired May 2023. Although I love the camaraderie and team spirit at PDS, my journey in life is taking me in another direction. My wife cannot work due to a disability and I'm unable to provide place for us to live together in Orange County because of the high cost of living. We are currently looking for new employment that will allow us to move to Idaho where I can provide a place we can call home on just my income alone. Whether that job is on-site, hybrid or remote, we are diligently searching and applying.

We eagerly await the next chapter life has in store for us.

company.name: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare

positions.title: Jr Software Developer
positions.description:
Collaborate with a development team using Agile methodologies to maintain and enhance company intranet and databases.
Handle support tickets and database management, enhancing system functionality and user experience.
Conduct code reviews and coordinate with the DevOps team for seamless software deployments.
Responsible for producing monthly reports utilizing SQL Server Integration Services.
Created new SQL tables and stored procedures to facilitate Payroll team updates for total wage and bonus calculations specific to employees in the state of California.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · Powershell · AngularJS · TypeScript · JavaScript · HTML · Atlassian Bamboo · Jira · Confluence · Kanban · Git BASH · Lucidchart · .Net · C# · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Bitbucket · SQL

positions.title: Jr Programmer
positions.description:
In a team of 4 using .Net Core, SQL Server, C# and ReactJs to maintain website integrity and ensure a smooth user experience with multiple patch releases gradually raising sales up to 10% over the last year.
Used Visual Studio Community 2022 to write all C#, JavaScript, and React files and to merge and push code.
Utilized Git Bash to merge and push code while using Visual Studio Code.
Maintained and updated web services for more responsive online customer services which boosted sales by 15%.
Implemented a custom event tracker to trace customer behavior in junction with the company's Google Analytics account.
Learned and utilized Razor for the company's intranet services such as creating a new dashboard that includes announcements, inbox and time card for employees, and a list of job opportunities within the company.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Git · ASP.NET MVC · .NET Framework · REST APIs · HTML5 · C# · SQL · Node.js · React.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Material-UI · jQuery · Entity Framework · User Experience (UX) · Web Applications · Web Development · Next.js

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of full stack developers and two team leads to create an application through the .Net framework that simplifies searching providers for patients, allows a paperless way for doctors to stay up to date on their licenses and other important documents, and saves medical insurance companies money by keeping an accurate account of plans for patients and doctors.

  - Utilizing CRUD operations to manage database functionalities and integrate services with the front end.
- Integrating APIs with the web applications using Restful Web services and MVC.
- Designing front end features using React library along with Bootstrap framework.
- Conducting code reviews and version control with Git BASH with a cohort of 16 other full stack developers.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · SQL · React.js · JavaScript · Node.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Bootstrap (Framework) · .NET Core · HTML · Git BASH · Web Applications · Web Development · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · C# · User Experience (UX)
